newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that around 1,000 head were exported into the United States from Mexico at two crossing points on Wednesday.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although not enough of any one class or weight range to give test market prices.
Through Nogales, Arizona, around 800 steer calves were sold at firm prices compared to last week. "Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 91-101 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 81-91 cents/lb.
